crossRefs.note: With my whole heart, I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.
Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out…
Hear, Yahweh, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
They haven’t cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new…
let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and having…
When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, Yahweh.”
Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.
Let your loving kindness also come to me, Yahweh, your salvation, according to your word.
Do good to your servant, according to your word, Yahweh.
Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.
In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
In God, I will praise his word. In Yahweh, I will praise his word.
I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for…
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

translations.web: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.
translations.bsb: I have sought Your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to Your promise.
translations.kjv: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.
translations.asv: I entreated thy favor with my whole heart: Be merciful unto me according to thy word.
